bugClass.title: Blocker inbox omits in-progress rows with blocker notes
bugClass.cause: A blocker inbox filters rows using a flag/status field but fails to include in-progress rows whose current blocker note independently marks them as blocked. The same eligibility contract can be missed in sibling CLI or API list paths.
bugClass.criteria: A site exhibits this cause if a blocker-focused list omits an in-progress item with a current blocker note when its explicit flag is unset. Each relevant list path can exhibit the failure independently; status summaries that intentionally show only status and flags do not qualify.

candidates.evidence: Lines 131–143 calculate when a note-derived blocker started using its note clock and fallbacks. This supports blocker-note handling but does not show blocker inbox eligibility, so omission of unflagged in-progress rows cannot be established.

Lines 10–24 derive the card's working items using inProgressItems and read blockedCount from card.counts.blocked. The excerpt does not show how blocker notes or explicit flags affect the card's data or rendering, so it cannot establish the omission mechanism.

`TrackerItemRow` includes optional `blocker_note` and `blocker_note_clock` fields (`TrackerItemReadRepository.types.ts:28–29`), but the excerpt shows only the row type, not a blocker-list filter or its eligibility rules.
